definitions.explanation: the arrangement or installation of electrical wires or cables

examples.japanese: パソコンの{配線|はいせん}を{整理|せいり}した。
{電気工事士|でんきこうじし}が{家|いえ}の{配線|はいせん}を{点検|てんけん}してくれた。
examples.english: An electrician inspected the wiring in my house.

notes:
{配線|はいせん} refers to electrical wiring or the act of wiring.

COMPOSITION:
- {配|はい}: To distribute, arrange
- {線|せん}: Wire, line

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配線|はいせん}する (to wire, to install wiring)
- {配線|はいせん}{工事|こうじ} (wiring work)
- {配線|はいせん}{図|ず} (wiring diagram)
- {電気|でんき}{配線|はいせん} (electrical wiring)
- {屋内|おくない}{配線|はいせん} (indoor wiring)
- {配線|はいせん}を{引|ひ}く (to run wiring)

RELATED TERMS:
- ケーブル (cable)
- コード (cord)
- {電線|でんせん} (electric wire)
- {回路|かいろ} (circuit)

REGISTER: Neutral. Technical vocabulary commonly used in construction, IT, and everyday contexts.
